2609.28048.title: TEMPS: Temporal Sentence Embeddings for Temporal Information Retrieval
2609.28048.paper_summary: Modern information retrieval (IR) systems rarely represent time, yet many information needs depend on it: in clinical, journalistic, and legal search, when an event occurred can decide whether a document is relevant. Dense retrievers and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines match queries to documents well on topic but poorly on time, so they surface content that is on-topic yet temporally wrong. We introduce Temporal Textual Similarity (TTS), a task that measures how well two anchored texts align in time, independent of their topical similarity. We then present TEMPS (Temporal Embedding Model for Precise Search), a modular temporal branch that attaches to a frozen semantic retriever and trains on that signal. It resolves anchored temporal expressions to intervals and moment-matches each one to a Gaussian; the resulting ordering supervises an anchor-date-conditioned encoder, whose score we fuse with the semantic score at inference. Grounding supplies the supervision, so training uses no hand-labeled temporal data. The temporal score itself is the Gaussian-KL inclusion measure from distributional embeddings; what TEMPS adds is the grounding and the moment-matched supervision. On three temporal benchmarks, TEMPS improves MRR for every semantic backbone tested and, on TS- Retriever, lifts R@1 from 19.92 to 25.39 over the prior temporal state of the art.
2609.28048.paper_summary_zh: 現代資訊檢索（IR）系統很少考慮時間，然而許多資訊需求依賴於此：在臨床、新聞和法律搜索中，事件發生的時間可以決定文件的相關性。密集檢索器和檢索增強生成（RAG）管道在主題上能夠很好地匹配查詢和文件，但在時間上表現不佳，因此它們會顯示出主題正確但時間錯誤的內容。我們引入了時間文本相似度（TTS），這是一項衡量兩個固定文本在時間上如何對齊的任務，與它們的主題相似性無關。接著，我們介紹了TEMPS（精確搜索的時間嵌入模型），這是一個模組化的時間分支，附加在一個凍結的語義檢索器上並基於該信號進行訓練。它將固定的時間表達式解析為區間，並將每一個與高斯分佈進行時間匹配；所得到的排序用來監督一個以錨日期為條件的編碼器，其分數在推理時與語義分數融合。基於錨點的監督提供了指導，因此訓練不使用手動標記的時間數據。時間分數本身是來自分佈嵌入的高斯-KL包含度量；TEMPS所增加的是基於錨點的監督和時間匹配的指導。在三個時間基準上，TEMPS提高了每個測試的語義骨幹的MRR，並且在TS-Retriever上，將R@1從19.92提升至25.39，超越了之前的時間技術水平。
